notes: SEF Supplemental Budget No. 02-2026 (not the annual budget): 5 scanned pages. p-1 and p-2 are Local School Board Resolution No. MCKC-009, Series of 2026 (excerpt from the minutes of the 6th Regular Meeting of the Local School Board, City Mayor's Conference Room, July 30, 2026; approved July 30, 2026; motion by Member Furuta, seconded by Member Ochea). p-3 to p-5 are printed "Page 1 of 3" to "Page 3 of 3": LBP Form No. 8 (Certified Statement of Funding Sources as of July 29, 2026) and two LBP Form No. 9 pages.

Resolution: approves the reversion of appropriations from completed and discontinued SEF projects and activities totaling P2,522,509.00 (Annex A, Schedule of Reversion) and Supplemental Budget No. 02-2026 totaling P2,522,509.00 (Annex B) for Medical and Laboratory Supplies Expenses (weighing scales for the School-Based Feeding Program), Other General Services (School Infrastructure Technical Support and Project Development Program: hiring of draftsmen) and Lot Acquisition for Babag National High School (additional appropriation).
period.asOf is the funding-source certification date (July 29, 2026); the resolution itself is dated July 30, 2026.

Schedule of Reversion (reversion-schedule): sections are the printed program groups (elementary 3321, secondary 3322, nonFormal 3323), not expense classes; all reverted items are capital outlay continuing appropriations (1-07-... codes). Account codes are printed in a column offset from the wrapped descriptions; they were matched to items in printed order (12 secondary and 6 non-formal codes for 12 and 6 items).

Supplemental appropriation: the Elementary sub-total (1,323,549.00) is all MOOE and the Secondary Education sub-total (1,198,960.00) is all CO, so summary.mooe and summary.capitalOutlay take those printed sub-totals; no PS is appropriated.
